content:
The four angles in the upper semicircle sum to \(180^\circ\). Thus the shaded sector has central angle

\[
\theta=180^\circ-40^\circ-45^\circ-25^\circ=70^\circ.
\]

For a uniformly chosen point, the probability is the ratio of the shaded sector’s area to the entire disk’s area:

\[
P=\frac{\frac{70}{360}\pi r^2}{\pi r^2}
=\frac{70}{360}
=\frac{7}{36}.
\]

\[
\boxed{\frac{7}{36}}
\]
